summary: Retry thin viewport-edge hit tests only inside proven plain opaque paint; preserve real clipping, unknown measurements, and sample counts.
invariants: Only childless opaque HTML DIV surfaces <=1px at viewport edges qualify after original owner hit tests fail.
At most two interior probes remain strictly inside original paint, viewport, and clipping bounds; original sample must be inside clip.
Ancestor mapping, paint, border/radius overflow clips, containment, visibility, and clip margin exclusions remain fail-closed.
Reprobes use actual hit stacks and unchanged occluder logic; no sample, denominator, unknown threshold, or safety gate is dropped.
Original HTML, PNG, owner geometry and style remain unchanged; DOM, measurement and occlusion cache versions advance together.
forbidden: Do not infer visible paint from geometry alone or treat unsupported clipping and missing owner hits as measured clear.
Do not expand to text, replaced elements, transparent or complex paint without separately proven support.
